lines.t: This 2010 livestream helped start Minecraft's biggest legend.

full.credit: Clips: Brocraft stream (2010); SeaWattgaming; Lessons in Meme Culture (YouTube)

lines.t: That year, someone posted on 4chan about a player with white eyes in their single player world, named Herobrine.

full.credit: Clips: Brocraft stream (2010); SeaWattgaming; Lessons in Meme Culture (YouTube)

lines.t: Then streamers started faking their own sightings, live.

full.credit: Clips: Brocraft stream (2010); SeaWattgaming; Lessons in Meme Culture (YouTube)

lines.t: He was never actually in the game. But Mojang still jokes about removing him in update notes.

full.credit: Clips: Brocraft stream (2010); SeaWattgaming; Lessons in Meme Culture (YouTube)
